Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 22

“There is nothing in the three worlds that I need to do, Partha, nothing unattained that I need to attain — and yet I engage in action.”

Krishna offers himself as the case study. He meets the exemption of verse seventeen completely and works anyway, which reframes action as something other than a response to lack.
